verdicts.reason: A keeps the label with all its text inside, so the brand lockup survives, but the text is tiny. The label's two divider lines and a dash have come loose and float in empty space at the top right. The illustrations are spread thinly along the bottom with gaps between them. B pulls every text element out of the label and leaves it as an empty frame with stray rules in it. J'adore Paris, LAVANDER and SKINCARE drift to the left and HOMEMADE LOTION sits on the right, so the brand lockup is broken. The product illustrations are shrunk into a cramped strip, so the design is barely recognisable as the same one.
